Presenting the full video song "Achha Sila Diya Toone Mere Pyar Ka " from the Bollywood movie 'Bewafa Sanam' featuring Krishan Kumar & Shilpa Shirodkar in the lead roles. This song is sung by Sonu Nigam and the music is composed by Nikhil, Vinay, Milind Sagar.
Song: Achha Sila Diya Toone Mere Pyar Ka
Movie: Bewafa Sanam
Singer: Sonu Nigam
Star Cast: Krishan Kumar, Shilpa Shirodkar
Music Director: Nikhil-Vinay
Lyrics: Yogesh
Music Label: T-Series
